description: wlthy is a net worth tracker for cross-border wealth. See your full portfolio, debts, and multi-currency cash flows across countries in one place, in any of 13 currencies. Import broker and bank statements, then break down allocation by asset class, loan-to-value, and FX exposure. Informational tracking only, not investment, tax or legal advice. wlthy never moves money or trades on your behalf.
